description: Search the loaded affiliate product feeds by keywords. Returns products with price, merchant and a buy link. Filters: price range, currency (no conversion), network, merchant. Use the returned `ref` in other tools.

currency.description: ISO code, e.g. EUR. Only products in this currency match.

merchant.description: Restrict to merchants whose name contains this text.

network.description: Restrict to one affiliate network key.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'noise cancelling headphones'. Diacritics are ignored.

sub_id.description: Optional tracking tag (e.g. a campaign or post name).

name: search_products
title: Search products
